release.title: Ringo
release.notes:
First Canadian pressing with the correct title for track A2 "Have You Seen My Baby" on the label.

This still contains two misprints that are shared with the [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/3337601]other Canadian misprint release[/url]:
- Track A2 "Have You Seen My Baby" incorrectly listed as "Hold On" on the back cover.
- Track B3 "Six O'Clock" has an incorrect duration of 5:26 on the label.

Issued with a 24-page lithograph and lyric booklet.

Pressed by is uncredited and is identified by Customatrix plating info in combination with a 2.70" pressing ring on the labels.

Runouts are etched apart from [l186075]'s "TML" and [l586613]'s symbol "o", which are stamped.
